'''Daniel J. Cosgrove''' (born 1952) is an American biologist and author, currently the [[Robert E. Eberly|Eberly Family]] Chair of Biology at the [[Eberly College of Science]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://science.psu.edu/about/honors/endowed |title=Holders of Endowed Chairs |publisher=science.psu.edu |accessdate=August 22, 2016}}</ref> [[Pennsylvania State University]]. As an author and scientist, he is widely cited by his peers<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=85KkItgAAAAJ&hl=en |title=Daniel J. Cosgrove |accessdate=August 22, 2016}}</ref> and also held in libraries worldwide.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/np-cosgrove,%20daniel%20j/ |title=Cosgrove, Daniel J. |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=August 22, 2016}}</ref>
